ia.title: Tutored Project
ia.subtitle: Experience & Delivery
ia.description: Year-long team project carried out as part of the BTS SIO programme.
ia.content:
BTS SIO Tutored Project

As part of the BTS SIO programme, I took part in a team tutored project. It allowed me to apply all the skills acquired during my training.

  • Requirements analysis and specification writing.
  • Database design and wireframing.
  • Front-end and back-end development (HTML, CSS, PHP, JS).
  • Testing, acceptance and deployment.
  • Technical and user documentation.

dev.title: Database
dev.subtitle: Administration & Queries
dev.description: Setting up and administering databases using WAMP Server.
dev.content:
Relational Databases

During this year I learned to design, administer and query relational databases in a local environment using WAMP Server.

  • Installing and configuring WAMP (Apache, MySQL, PHP).
  • Relational schema modelling (ERD, logical model).
  • Writing SQL queries: SELECT, JOIN, GROUP BY, subqueries.
  • Managing MySQL users and permissions.
  • Using phpMyAdmin for administration.

strat.title: Confidential Data
strat.subtitle: GDPR & Security
strat.description: Protecting personal and confidential data, GDPR compliance.
strat.content:
Data Protection & GDPR

The BTS SIO programme raised my awareness of the legal and technical issues around personal and confidential data in business.

  • Core GDPR principles (consent, right to erasure, portability).
  • Classifying sensitive business data.
  • Access rights management and password policies.
  • Encryption at rest and in transit.
  • Drafting a compliant privacy policy.

cro.title: Network Infrastructure
cro.subtitle: System Administration
cro.description: Setting up and administering network infrastructures in local and virtualised environments.
cro.content:
Networking & System Administration

A key part of the BTS SIO SISR track is mastering network infrastructures, virtualisation, and system administration.

  • Router and switch configuration (Cisco Packet Tracer).
  • VLAN setup and IP addressing (IPv4/IPv6).
  • Linux (Debian) administration: SSH, FTP, DNS, DHCP services.
  • Virtualisation with VirtualBox / VMware.
  • Network monitoring and incident detection.

flow.title: Web Development
flow.subtitle: HTML · CSS · PHP · JS
flow.description: Building dynamic websites and web applications using modern web technologies.
flow.content:
Full Stack Web Development

During my BTS SIO training I developed several web projects using modern front-end and back-end technologies.

  • Responsive HTML5 / CSS3 integration (Flexbox, Grid).
  • JavaScript interactivity (DOM, events, fetch API).
  • PHP back-end: form handling, sessions, MySQL CRUD.
  • WordPress site creation and theme customisation.
  • Deployment on Apache servers (WAMP / shared hosting).

ethics.title: Technology Watch
ethics.subtitle: Curiosity & Staying Current
ethics.description: Regular technology monitoring to stay up to date in the IT sector.
ethics.content:
Technology & Information Watch

Technology monitoring is a key BTS SIO skill: it keeps you up to date with the fast-moving IT sector and helps you anticipate emerging practices.

  • Following specialist sources: Reddit (r/netsec, r/programming), Hacker News, GitHub Trending.
  • Regular reading of tech blogs (MDN, CSS-Tricks, ANSSI).
  • Setting up an RSS feed aggregator (Feedly).
  • Writing technology watch summaries for the E4/E5 portfolio.
  • Tracking CVEs and security alerts (CERT-FR).
